title: Compose capability, impact, trust, and approval into one authority gate
narrative: Hard rules for consequential actions must live outside model text. Untrusted forwarded content must not authorize an external send; high-impact reversible trades still require the configured authority. Related native paths: `fangore_insp_risk_autonomy`, `fangore_jev_action_safety`, `fangore_compound_grants`. Tracks MH-PA-02[^insp-pa-02].
implementation: Axes exist separately (AccessPolicy/grants, CapabilityEnvelope, ConsequencePolicy, JudgementPolicy, approval interrupt). Desired: one authority gate composing capability, reversibility, impact, source trust, and explicit approval.
validation: Kind `inspiration_delta_contract`. Soft expects requirement_id MH-PA-02, coverage partial, adjacent_ok, probes_ok with typed surface probes encoding the current product delta.
